Definition: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
BiblicalUsage: Jehovah is the name by which God made Himself known to Israel, the name He gave when He brought them out of Egypt. In Genesis 2:4, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name of the LORD is not a word I use lightly; He told Moses who He is, and I trust the God who keeps His name.
